_comment: Single option. EVERY media is scoped: an unscoped media is only safe first, and a first-and-unscoped media pins the main image for all variants. Pack frames lead so the main image follows the Scent dropdown.
_comment_frankincence_keys: The two frankincence KEYS keep the pre-2026-08-18 spelling on purpose. Keys match by FILENAME FRAGMENT against media already uploaded to Shopify, and those files are named frame-*-d4-4x-wildcrafted-frankincence.jpg. The VALUES are the live option value and were corrected with it. A key that matches no media is not inert: this file must describe every scoped media, so an unmatched media has its suffix STRIPPED and then renders for no variant at all. Renaming the keys therefore requires re-rendering and re-uploading the frames in the same change.
